intervals.label: collaboration formed; EIC project detector technical design
intervals.locator: arXiv:2305.15593, section on the technical design
intervals.note: July 2022: ePIC collaboration formed to lead the technical design of the EIC project detector. "approved" here means selected as the EIC project detector; the end bound is the day before the first long-lead procurements (April 2024) that included detector components.
intervals.quote: a new detector collaboration: ePIC has been formed in July 2022 to lead the EIC project detector technical design based on the EIC reference design

intervals.label: construction (long-lead procurement of detector components)
intervals.locator: BNL Newsroom, 13 April 2026 ("being designed and constructed"); CD-3A/CD-3B procurements include detector items (silicon photomultipliers, solenoid power supply, crystals, fibres, electronics)
intervals.note: BNL describes ePIC as "being designed and constructed" and the CD-3A/CD-3B packages buy detector components, but no source states the date the detector construction phase formally began; April 2024 is the date of the first approved procurements. The same BNL pages say the EIC is preparing a "formal transition into the construction phase".

placements.note: Planned: the STAR detector, in the same hall, is to be taken apart to make way for ePIC. The placement start is the planned operating date, not an installation date.

length.quote: The ePIC Central Detector is very compact spanning a cylindrical volume that is about 9.5m longitudinally and 2.67m radially, covering an acceptance of about 3°-177°

solenoid_field.quote: instrumented within a 1.7T magnetic field, generated from a 2.8m bore diameter superconducting solenoid magnet

summary.plain: A cylindrical detector about 9.5 metres long built around a large solenoid magnet, with silicon and gas trackers, particle-identification layers and calorimeters, plus detectors far along the beam pipes.
summary.technical: ePIC central detector (about 9.5 m long, 2.67 m radius, 3-177 degrees) in a 1.7 T field from a 2.8 m bore superconducting solenoid: silicon vertex/tracking layers and micro-pattern gas detectors (about 7.5 m^2 and 34.4 m^2), fast timing and Cherenkov PID, electromagnetic and hadronic calorimeters; far-forward and far-backward detectors extend the acceptance to |eta| > 6.

technology.quote: instrumented within a 1.7T magnetic field, generated from a 2.8m bore diameter superconducting solenoid magnet
technology.value: Compact general-purpose collider detector: silicon and micro-pattern gas tracking in a 1.7 T solenoid, fast-timing and Cherenkov PID, electromagnetic and hadronic calorimeters, plus far-forward and far-backward detectors
